title: Eleanor AI: Intelligent Productivity Assistant
challenge: Professionals struggle to stay on top of day-to-day activities, meeting notes, document references, scheduling, and research across Google Workspace. Information is scattered across emails, Google Meet transcripts, Google Docs, and calendar events. Without a unified assistant, users waste time searching for information, miss important updates, and lack insights into their work patterns. Users need a daily assistant that can track activities, extract insights from meetings, reference documents, schedule events, provide actionable insights, and perform research—all while understanding context across their entire Google Workspace.
whyNow: Information scattered across emails, meetings, and documents
Need to track day-to-day activities and follow-ups
Meeting notes and insights often lost or forgotten
Time wasted searching for information across Google Workspace
Lack of unified view of work activities and patterns
Demand for proactive insights and research assistance
whyNowSummary: As work becomes increasingly digital and distributed, professionals need a daily assistant that can track activities, extract insights from meetings, reference documents, and provide research—all while understanding context across their entire Google Workspace. Traditional tools require constant manual management, creating a need for an intelligent assistant that acts as a unified knowledge base and activity tracker.
solution: A daily AI assistant that integrates seamlessly with Google Workspace to track day-to-day activities, extract and update from Google Meet notes, reference Google Docs intelligently, schedule events proactively, provide actionable insights, and perform research. Eleanor understands context across all Google services, learns user patterns, and acts as a unified knowledge base and activity tracker while keeping users in control.
